episode_summary: In this episode, Justin Black shares how he uses AI to optimize his real estate business, focusing on creating a website that ranks in AI search results and using personalized FedEx packages to convert expired listings. He provides actionable insights on leveraging technology to generate high-value leads in the luxury market.
